title: Employee onboarding
description: Preparation, first assignments and feedback for a new employee's entry into a team.

sources.title: U.S. Office of Personnel Management, Sample supervisor onboarding checklist

rules.instruction: Before the start date, assign an owner for equipment, approved account access, introductions and the first work assignment. Keep the plan accessible to the new employee and manager.
rules.verification: Walk through the checklist with each owner and confirm that the employee's role can complete the first assignment with the access requested.

rules.instruction: Schedule onboarding check-ins that cover role expectations, learning goals and practical blockers. Give each unresolved blocker an owner and an agreed follow-up date.
rules.verification: At a check-in, review the employee's feedback and trace outstanding items to a person and a date the employee can use.
